title: Wind turbine
prompt: a wind turbine with the nacelle cut open: the wind picks up, the blades pitch and turn, the generator lights a house at the base, yaw to face the wind, brake in a storm; see-through shows the hub, pitch motors, main shaft, gearbox, generator, yaw drive and tower cables
blurb: Raise the wind and the blades bite, pitch to hold 2 MW and light the house below; swing the wind and the yaw motors turn the nacelle to face it; a storm feathers the blades and clamps the brake.
